purpose: Allow the bootstrap initialization analysis to scale to the expanded Stage1 candidate without changing definite-initialization semantics, diagnostics, CFG joins, or public detailed-report meaning.

legacy_cost_shape.dense_entry_pressure: O(total_memory_cells * reachable_blocks) persistent report/state entries plus transfer/join copies
legacy_cost_shape.risk: Large fixed-array-heavy compiler candidates can create tens of millions of Python dict entries even when the semantic information is only two bits per cell.

allowed: packed tri-state vector with equivalent semantics
another representation with no worse asymptotic persistent state and proven equivalence

cell_encoding.forbidden: initialized=1 maybe=1 unless explicitly normalized and proven equivalent

report_policy.public_detailed_report: When a caller explicitly requests the InitializationReport, entry/exit cell states must preserve the legacy observable meaning and deterministic ordering.
report_policy.internal_validation_only: Callers that only need pass/fail validation should not materialize per-cell entry/exit report tuples.

semantic_invariants: constant-index LOAD of definitely uninitialized memory raises the same initialization diagnostic
second constant-index STORE to immutable already-initialized memory raises the same immutable-write diagnostic
unknown-index STORE marks each previously-uninitialized cell in that memory object maybe-initialized
CFG join of different predecessor states yields maybe-initialized
unreachable blocks do not affect reachable-state joins
memory mutability and length checks remain unchanged
constant propagation used for memory indices remains semantically unchanged
verify_ir still runs before initialization analysis
report/no-report modes validate the same program with the same success or exception class/code
qualification_gates: existing focused initialization semantic suite passes unchanged
new equivalence tests compare detailed and validation-only modes on joins, unknown indices, immutable writes, and uninitialized loads
expanded Stage1 candidate completes Stage0/native preparation without OOM attributable to initialization-state materialization
no performance result is promoted to compiler correctness evidence by itself
prohibited: changing S3 source semantics to make analysis cheaper
treating unknown-index STORE as fully initializing the whole memory object
suppressing initialization errors in validation-only mode
claiming PASS from lower memory usage without semantic regression tests
